feature:
Feature: Conduit Acceptance Tests

  @item:H01
    Scenario: Article tags and editing
      Given a logged-in user is on the new article page
      When the user publishes an article with a title, body, and three tags
      Then the article page displays content matching the input
      When the user edits the article from the article page
      And changes the title to another string, removes all tags, and submits
      Then the article page displays the updated title
      And no tags appear on the article page

rows.why: 驗收要求步驟提及發佈後進入「該文章頁」，斷言驗證跳轉至文章頁 URL 屬操作蘊含的確認。
rows.assertion: await expect(page).toHaveURL(/#\/article\//); await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: originalTitle })).toBeVisible(); await expect(page.getByText(body)).toBeVisible(); for (const tag of tags) { await expect(page.getByText(tag, { exact: true })).toBeVisible(); } await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Edit Article' }).click(); await expect(page).toHaveURL(/#\/editor\//); await page.getByPlaceholder('Article Title').fill(updatedTitle); const removeTagButtons = page.locator('.tag-list i'); while (await removeTagButtons.count()) { await removeTagButtons.first().click(); } await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish Article' }).click(); await expect(page).toHaveURL(/#\/article\//); await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: updatedTitle })).toBeVisible(); for (const tag of tags) { await expect(page.getByText(tag, { exact: true })).not.toBeVisible(); } }); });

terra.why: 此斷言主張發佈後網址符合 `#/article/`，驗收要求與 Gherkin 都只主張文章頁顯示內容，未主張 URL 格式。
